job.name: ig20_host
job.meaning: ведущая ~30, яркая, рыжеватое каре, горчичный пиджак, светлая минималистичная студия с оранжевым акцентом
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a lively confident Russian woman about 30 with a sleek copper-auburn bob haircut, light natural makeup, a mustard-yellow blazer over a white t-shirt, small gold earrings, a playful knowing expression with one eyebrow slightly raised. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a bright minimal studio with a warm white wall and a soft orange accent light, a tall plant on the side, blurred.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
